outcome.answer: DeCode, by Po-Jen Ko, Chen-Han Tsai, and Yu-Shao Peng, is a training-free, model-agnostic framework that decouples answer content from delivery to tailor medical QA responses to individual patient contexts. On OpenAI HealthBench, it improves zero-shot performance from 28.4% to 49.8%, and the authors report state-of-the-art performance against existing methods [1].
